findings.claim: The commit changes the shared ConfirmDialog component to render through a portal, which is not in the touch-point list and reaches every ConfirmDialog caller in the app.
findings.impact: Every screen that opens ConfirmDialog now renders it under document.body rather than in its parent, so any caller that relied on its containing element for stacking, event handling or styling changes behaviour without spec coverage. Only the Smart Collection and FileContextMenu tests exercise it.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/ConfirmDialog.tsx:43-84 (createPortal(..., document.body) added). The touch-point list names no ConfirmDialog.tsx. frontend/src/components/__tests__/FileContextMenu.test.tsx:296-306 was edited to mock the dialog with a portal, showing the change ripples into an unrelated test.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. Mutation check not run; the claim rests on the diff and the touch-point list.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant is broken by the portal itself, but a shared component changed outside the declared touch points, with no spec or test for its other callers.

findings.proposed_fix: Move the portal into a spec-listed change or revert it for ConfirmDialog and handle the Smart Collection dialogs' containment locally.
